title: SimEX: Simulation-Integrated Robotics AutoResearch
abstract: arXiv:2609.38982v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Coding agents powered by large language models (LLMs) have shown remarkable abilities to autonomously reason about and achieve goals in the digital world. However, bringing this success to the physical world remains challenging. On the one hand, direct generation methods (e.g., Code as Policies) often suffer from the LLMs' insufficient understanding of robots and physical environments. On the other hand, iterative trial-and-error tuning in the physical world (e.g., physical autoresearch) induces significant experimental cost and safety concerns. We introduce SimEX: Simulation-Integrated Robotics AutoResearch, an autoresearch framework that tightly integrates simulated experimentation, enabling coding agents to efficiently acquire physical capabilities for controlling real robots. translated_title: SimEX：仿真集成的机器人自动研究框架
translated_abstract: 由大语言模型（LLM）驱动的编程智能体（coding agents）已经展现出在数字世界中自主推理并实现目标的卓越能力。然而，将这一成功推广到物理世界仍然充满挑战。一方面，直接生成方法（例如 Code as Policies）往往受限于 LLM 对机器人和物理环境理解的不足；另一方面，在物理世界中进行迭代的试错调优（例如物理自动研究）会带来高昂的实验成本和安全隐忧。我们提出了 SimEX：仿真集成的机器人自动研究框架，这是一个紧密集成仿真实验的自动研究框架，使编程智能体能够高效地获得控制真实机器人的物理能力。SimEX 分为两个阶段运行。首先，智能体在仿真环境中进行开放式的“探索-优化”迭代，构建一个具有鲁棒性和泛化能力的机器人工具箱……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: SimEX 提出了一个将仿真实验深度集成到自动研究流程中的框架，让 LLM 编程智能体通过仿真中开放式的探索-优化迭代高效获得控制真实机器人的能力，从而规避了直接生成方法对物理世界理解不足以及真实物理试错带来的高成本与安全风险。
en_tdlr: SimEX is a simulation-integrated autoresearch framework that enables LLM-powered coding agents to efficiently acquire physical capabilities for controlling real robots through open-ended probe-and-optimize iterations in simulation, avoiding the high cost and safety risks of physical trial-and-error.
